versions.content: DRAFT When a Null pointer has been passed to a FrNm service, the called function shall not be executed and it shall return E_NOT_OK to the calling function if applicable. If development error detection is enabled (FrNmDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE) the corresponding error FRNM_E_PARAM_POINTER shall be reported to DET.
